interpretation: Evidence-informed living reconstruction. 20 trunk segments are an illustrative count within the observed range, not a taxon-fixed count. Each paired parapodium has separate dorsal 3-strand and wider ventral 4-strand fans; counts deliberately simplified from reported maxima. The head carries a separate pair of chaetal tufts. Paired long palps and one much shorter median antenna; a simple unappendaged pygidium. Thickness, pose, bristle proportions and muted earth palette are artistic. No invented eyes, jaws, rig or behavior. The 25 mm length is the body centerline excluding all palps, antenna and chaetae.
normal_style: Smooth body and appendage lofts on low-sided deliberate cross sections; flat triangular chaetae. Single-sided closed meshes.
